pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Be2 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file; plan 1 proposed Bh6 without Qd2. Reworded plans 1 and 2; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 4 recaptured on f6 with the g-pawn, which cannot reach f6, and claimed an open g-file; the overview called Bg5 a pin; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 4 (the reviewer caught that after ...exf6 the f6-pawn blocks the g7-bishop).

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.Bg5
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Reworded plan 2.

pages.name: Sicilian: Dragon, 6.g3 Nc6
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Nge2 with no knight on g1 (it is Nde2). Corrected plan 1; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Levenfish Variation, Main Line
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black meet e5 with ...Nf6-b8 and missed that the d7-knight already covers e5; plan 1 combined Nf3 and Qf3. Rewrote both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation
pages.notes: Plan 4 had ...Rxc3 with no rook on the c-file; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8; plan 3 had Bh6 without Qd2. Reworded plans 1-4; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 said the 7.Be2 Classical leads to the Yugoslav Attack with long castling and f3; plan 2 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote the overview and both plans.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White castle long with a pawn storm as the main plan; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8; plan 3 had ...Rxc3. Rewrote plans 1-3.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation, Classical Variation, Amsterdam Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a sacrifice Bxh6 with no pawn on h6; plan 2 had ...Rc8 with the bishop on c8. Rewrote the overview and plans 1 and 2; British spelling in plans 3 and 4.

pages.name: Sicilian Defense: Dragon Variation: 7. Ng4??
pages.notes: The overview called 6...Ng4?? a major branch; it is a blunder to 7.Bb5+ (after 7...Bd7 the pinned bishop no longer guards g4, so 8.Qxg4 wins the knight; 7...Qd7 drops the queen to Bxd7+). Rewrote the overview and all four plans.
